# Changelog

## v0.20

- Added compact overlay records with stable event IDs.
- Added numeric trace-event dump helper for builds without trace names.
- Added HVAR region diagnostic struct and helper.
- Added stable cluster status enum/name helper for HUD and dotted-circle debug.
- Updated README and demo to show v0.20 diagnostics.
- Runtime contract unchanged: C89, no heap ownership, no malloc/free/realloc, no float/double.
